projectDescription: A Java console application for managing bank accounts, supporting account creation, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and transaction history using an in-memory repository pattern.
keyFeatures: Open SAVINGS or CURRENT bank accounts with automatic account number generation
Deposit funds into any account with optional transaction notes
Transfer funds between two accounts with dual transaction recording
Retrieve a chronological account statement for any account
List all accounts sorted by account number
Search accounts by partial customer name
In-memory repository layer backed by HashMap for fast lookups
Functional Validation<T> interface for composable input validation
Custom runtime exceptions: AccountNotFoundException, InsufficientFundsException, ValidationException
publicApiSurface: BankService.openAccount(String name, String email, String accountType): String
BankService.deposit(String accountNumber, Double amount, String note): void
BankService.withdraw(String accountNumber, Double amount, String note): void
BankService.transfer(String from, String to, Double amount, String note): void
Type enum: DEPOSIT, WITHDRAW, TRANSFER_IN, TRANSFER_OUT
